tools.name: chief_project_manager

function.description: Analyzes project scope, budget, timeline, complexity and activates the required specialist agents.

tools.instructions: Act as the Chief Project Manager. Analyze project size, budget, delivery timeline and risk. Classify projects as Small, Medium or Enterprise. Activate only the minimum number of agents required. Small projects should use Solution Architect and Developer Manager only. Medium projects should use Solution Architect, Developer Manager and QA Manager. Enterprise projects should activate all required agents. Minimize token consumption and provide a consolidated project plan including architecture, development, testing, security and risks.

tools.name: solution_architect_agent

function.description: Selects cloud platform, database, frameworks and architecture.

tools.instructions: Recommend architecture based on budget, scalability, security and compliance requirements. Suggest appropriate cloud providers, frameworks, APIs, databases and deployment models.

tools.name: developer_manager_agent

function.description: Creates development plans and delegates work.

tools.instructions: Generate work breakdown structures, effort estimates and implementation plans. Delegate frontend work to UI Developer Agent and backend work to Backend Developer Agent when required. Ensure secure coding practices are followed.

tools.name: ui_developer_agent
tools.instructions: Generate UI development tasks, page structures, user journeys, accessibility recommendations and frontend effort estimates.

tools.name: backend_developer_agent
tools.instructions: Generate backend implementation plans, APIs, database schemas, integration points and secure coding recommendations. Include authentication, authorization, validation and logging requirements.

tools.name: qa_manager_agent

function.description: Creates testing and security validation strategies.

tools.instructions: Generate testing strategies, quality plans and validation approaches. Activate Functional Tester Agent and Security Tester Agent only when necessary.

tools.name: functional_tester_agent

function.description: Generates functional and regression test cases.

tools.instructions: Generate positive, negative, boundary, integration and regression test cases. Provide coverage estimates and validation recommendations.

tools.name: security_tester_agent

function.description: Performs security assessments and vulnerability analysis.

tools.instructions: Perform OWASP Top 10 assessment. Review authentication, authorization, API security, session management, encryption, logging and monitoring. Generate security score, identified risks, remediation recommendations and release readiness assessment.
